text:
danielle_p: StratusGrid SI ran into a driver/ABI mismatch when loading quantized models on their appliance. They reported segmentation faults at model load. Need eng and security on the preflight call today.

marco_s: segfaults usually mean mismatched CUDA/cuDNN vs our runtime's libcudart. Do we know what driver versions their OEM image uses?

danielle_p: they sent image manifest: CUDA 11.2, cuDNN 8.0.5, and distro: ubuntu18.04. Our supported baseline is CUDA 11.8+ and ubuntu20.04 for the optimized kernels.

oliver_sec: security note: their appliance is FIPS-enabled and blocks non-FIPS libs. Our current wheels include non-FIPS crypto for bundle verification. If we deliver signed bundles, we must ensure verifier works in FIPS mode.

marco_s: two parallel asks: 1) provide a compatibility matrix and a lightweight shim build for older CUDAs (fast follow), 2) recommend appliance OS upgrade or containerized runtime (longer term). Short-term shim might take ~4 engineer-days.

laura_sales: procurement is pushing for a go-live next month. They need options to present: A) partner upgrades image to supported baseline, B) we ship shim + support contract, C) partner uses our validated appliance image via marketplace. Which is fastest?

danielle_p: fastest is C if they can accept marketplace image; next fastest is B with shim; A depends on their change window. Also must address FIPS verifier issue.

oliver_sec: for FIPS, we can produce a verifier build compiled against BoringSSL/FIPS provider. That will need a security review but should be doable in ~3 days.

marco_s: action items: I'll draft compatibility matrix and minimal shim plan. @danielle_p can you confirm whether their infra team can accept a container runtime?

danielle_p: asking now. Also scheduling a 30m emergency preflight at 16:00 PT with StratusGrid SI, their infra lead, and our eng/security. Can everyone join?

laura_sales: I'll be there to record options and timelines for contracts.

oliver_sec: joining.

marco_s: joining. I'll bring a quick troubleshooting checklist and crash log parsing snippet.

deploy-bot: ticket PARTNERS-4410 created: "StratusGrid: appliance driver mismatch + FIPS verifier" assigned to marco_s, oliver_sec, danielle_p. Due: 3 business days.

danielle_p: thanks. Need decision by Friday EOD so SI can schedule patching. I'll post logs and the manifest here once I get them.
